@__cryptocowboy @dogecoin $DOGE can be a BEP-20 coin but isn’t natively BEP-20. It’s a POW coin that was initially a fork of $LTC, using a scrypt algo to mine. The EVM compatible standard for DOGE is DRC-20, whereas BEP-20 is the standard on Binance’s smart chain.
